_meta.note: Every value below is copied from the gate output of a real run. No provider endpoint was contacted and no user project was opened.

checks.method: construct a provider with an empty credential store and record that every credentialed call is refused before any transport is built
checks.expected_outcome: a provider with no configured credential fails closed before any transport is used

checks.method: list models from a live-shaped provider, cache them, then break the provider and record that discovery falls back to the cache and rethrows when the cache is empty
checks.expected_outcome: model discovery returns the provider catalog and falls back to the cache when the provider is unreachable, rethrowing when no cache exists

checks.method: queue a generation job, run the queue, and record the terminal status and that a failing job ends failed rather than silently dropped
checks.expected_outcome: a queued job runs to completion and a failing job ends failed with its error recorded

checks.method: cancel a queued job and a running job and record that neither keeps producing output and that a cancelled job is not resurrected
checks.expected_outcome: a cancelled job stops producing output and its result is never persisted

checks.method: count the shipped writers of AI usage rows and record that a reader with no writer reports zero tokens rather than a provider number
checks.expected_outcome: a completed generation records its token usage against the provider that served it

checks.method: run an automated call with a configured price table and record that the cost line names the provider that served it, not the one requested
checks.expected_outcome: cost is attributed to the provider that served the call and is not invented when no price table is configured

checks.method: gate an allowlisted and an unknown destination and record that the unknown one is denied by default and audited
checks.expected_outcome: an unlisted destination is denied by default and every decision is audited

checks.method: fail the preferred provider and record that the next capable provider serves the request and is the provider cost and usage are booked to
checks.expected_outcome: a failed preferred provider falls back to a capable provider and the fallback provider is the one charged

checks.method: raise each transport error class a provider emits and record that the message never echoes credential material
checks.expected_outcome: a provider error surfaces without echoing credential material
